_readme: Ad inventory for MetaFlora News. House ads run by default. To sell a slot, add an entry with the advertiser's name, creative and a start/end date; set weight higher to show it more often. categories limits it to sections (empty = everywhere).

ads.title: Power your home grow
ads.body: The Home Grow Node box pairs verified seeds with Terra, an AI grow companion that coaches feeding, drybacks and harvest timing from your grow journal.

ads.title: Meet Terp, your AI budtender
ads.body: The Connoisseur Box learns your potency, terpene and cannabinoid preferences and helps you find the right product in any store.

ads.title: Become a node owner
ads.body: Join the MetaFlora Node Network and earn $FLORA for powering data and transactions across the cannabis platform.

ads.title: From seed to greatness
ads.body: Strain profiles, lab reports and verified genetics in one platform. Built for growers, retailers and connoisseurs.

ads.title: Put your brand in front of the cannabis industry
ads.body: MetaFlora News publishes a morning and an evening edition every day and pushes every lead story to X. Ad breaks like this one are open to partners.
